entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I need to start a return.
Hi there, you've reached Diana at VeloFit. I can definitely help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. Look, I'm a bit short on time. I just want to return these cycling shoes. Can I get a refund or not?

Okay, I'm pulling up order VF88602 now. I see the spin class shoes. To make sure I'm handling this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the cleats or more of a preference issue?
They don't fit right. I wore them once and they gave me blisters. I don't need a different size, I just want my money back.
I'm sorry to hear that, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for you. Let me quickly check the return eligibility for you.
It was delivered 11 days ago. It should be fine.
You are absolutely correct. I've confirmed it here. These shoes are covered by our 90-day return policy, so you're well within the timeframe. I can process this for a full refund for you right now.
Great. So you're sending a label?

Yes. I've just initiated the return and emailed a prepaid shipping label to the address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
